newsitem.title: UK: UK's FTSE 100 leaps to 7th straight closing peak.
newsitem.headline: UK's FTSE 100 leaps to 7th straight closing peak.

text.p: Britain's FTSE 100 index scaled its seventh consecutive record high on Monday, fuelled by another rally on Wall Street and unexpected news of a 23-billion stg merger between Grand Metropolitan Plc and Guinness Plc .
The FTSE finished 38.7 points higher at 4,669.6, just 0.3 point off its intraday high, as advancers outnumbered decliners by more than two to one.

The Dow was up some 72 points when Wall Street closed amid expectations the Federal Reserve will refrain from raising U.S. interest rates at its May 20 policy meeting. That, in turn, propelled UK shares to new heights.
Strategists at several brokerages raised their year-end targets for the FTSE 100 index as they factored in more favourable gilt yields.
